translations.web: Surely now they will say, “We have no king; for we don’t fear Yahweh; and the king, what can he do for us?”
translations.bsb: Surely now they will say, “We have no king, for we do not revere the LORD. What can a king do for us?”
translations.kjv: For now they shall say, We have no king, because we feared not the LORD; what then should a king do
translations.asv: Surely now shall they say, We have no king; for we fear not Jehovah; and the king, what can he do for us?
